comparison.objective: Move two cord-linked devices onto a shelf without tensioning their cord.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated transport of tethered objects and cord management, not adjuster manipulation or dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Everything rests on the shelf without dragging, hanging, or cord pulling. No numeric tension limit or spec versions are provided.
comparison.reason: The constrained transport ability is unrelated to commissioning an energy absorber.
